input.summary: Replace Arizona governing law with New York law and add exclusive venue in New York County courts
input.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law from Arizona to New York and added exclusive venue in the state and federal courts in New York County, consistent with our playbook's accepted jurisdictions. If New York does not work for you, we can accept Delaware, California, or England and Wales with the courts of London.

ops.oldText: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
ops.newText: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof. The parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York for any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement.
